exposure: Clinical characteristics (type of febrile convulsion, source of fever, family history of epilepsy/febrile convulsion, recurrence rate)
Laboratory characteristics (platelet counts, C-reactive protein levels, EEG findings)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 200 patients diagnosed with febrile convulsion who presented to a university hospital in Turkey between January 2014 and December 2018.
finding: The study found that 13% of patients with febrile convulsions developed epilepsy, and the rate of epilepsy diagnosis was significantly higher (81%) in those with abnormal EEG findings.
